import numpy as np
from scipy import linalg
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

rng = np.random.RandomState(1137)
n_samples = 500_000
n_features = 2

x1 = rng.rand(n_samples)
x2 = 0.3 * x1 + 0.1 * rng.rand(n_samples)
X = np.column_stack([x1, x2])
y = X @ np.array([0.5, 2.0]) + 0.1 * rng.rand(n_samples)

X = X.astype(np.float32)
y = y.astype(np.float32)

# sklearn LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression(fit_intercept=False)
model.fit(X, y)
coef_sklearn = model.coef_
rmse_sklearn = np.linalg.norm(y - X @ coef_sklearn)

# scipy.linalg.lstsq
coef_scipy, _, _, _ = linalg.lstsq(X, y)
rmse_scipy = np.linalg.norm(y - X @ coef_scipy)

ratio = rmse_sklearn / rmse_scipy

probe('sklearn_rmse', float(rmse_sklearn))
probe('scipy_rmse', float(rmse_scipy))
probe('rmse_ratio', float(ratio))
